title: Clear Salt Nic E-liquid – Simple Smooth 30ml
description:
Description
Flavourless with a hint of sweetness and ice.
Experience pure satisfaction with Clear Salt, offering a pristine selection of flavourless salt e-liquids. Dive into a clean, unadulterated vaping experience that lets you savour the true essence of your favourite e-juices. Pure, simple, smooth and satisfying!
Clear Salt-Nic E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Clear Salt-Nic E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
